subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB668
title: Expands tuition benefits available to disabled veterans to permit veterans who are Oregon residents and are 80 percent or more disabled, and the spouse and child of disabled veterans, to have tuition waived for enrollment in a vocational program or an associate degree, baccalaureate degree or master's degree program at community colleges, public universities and the Oregon Health and Science University.
headline: SB 668 did not pass

claims.text: SB 668 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SB 668 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 7 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.

timeline.text: Public hearing held in a Senate committee
Senate committee met to work on it
Senate committee sent it on with no recommendation
